title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
slides: FBI arrests OpenAI employee: what did they hear?
Devices found hidden in conference room walls.
But employee had access to top-secret AI projects.
Your meetings may be compromised. Secure your spaces now.
Trust but verify—especially in AI's closed doors.
thread_text:
1. What the FBI Heard

An OpenAI employee was arrested after agents discovered listening devices hidden inside conference room walls. The devices had been active for months.

2. Hidden in Plain Sight

The bugs were embedded in wall panels during a routine office renovation. No one noticed until a security sweep flagged unusual wiring.

3. Top-Secret Access

That same employee had clearance for unreleased AI models and internal safety research. Investigators are now reviewing every meeting he attended.

4. Your Meetings Are Next

If a top AI lab can be compromised, your startup's boardroom is an open book. Most offices never sweep for listening devices.

5. Test Your Own Space

Walk into your main meeting room and check for unexplained outlets or ceiling tiles. If you can't explain it, call a security firm this week.
